name: General-Graph Weighted Matching
problem_statement: Find a matching of high total nonnegative edge weight in an undirected graph without a bipartiteness assumption.

normalization: Preserve all declared vertices, including isolated vertices.
Preserve direction; an undirected projection must be explicitly requested.
Declare the treatment of self-loops and parallel edges before execution; an adapter must reject unsupported cases.

problem_inputs.name: solution_quality
problem_inputs.description: Whether a global optimum is required.

optional_outputs.name: approximation_ratio
optional_outputs.description: Certified ratio where the algorithm provides one.

solution_semantics.exactness: Approximate mode returns a feasible matching with any proven bound disclosed; exact mode requires optimal=true.
solution_semantics.duplicate_policy: Output identities refer to the normalized input; any multiplicities must follow the declared task.
solution_semantics.ordering: No output order or choice among equally valid optima is required unless specified by an input.

validation_rules: Every returned edge exists and no endpoint appears twice.
Validate any claimed approximation bound against small exact instances.
edge_cases: An odd cycle is valid input.
An edgeless graph has the empty matching.

correctness: Every returned edge exists and no endpoint appears twice.
